name: Typography Mask Reveal

behavior.description: Reveal the selected layer from bottom to top through a temporary external mask while its content eases upward into the authored pose.
behavior.targetSelection: Targets are alternatives. Choose one present hook name in the selected component and apply this reveal to each matching element together; never require every listed name.
behavior.keyframeTiming: at is seconds from start; easing applies to the interval from the current keyframe to the next.

mask.owner: temporary layout-preserving wrapper outside the target's authored visual layer
mask.progressMeaning: maskReveal 0 hides the entire wrapper; 1 reveals its complete bounds. Between them reveal the bottom maskReveal fraction of those fixed bounds.
mask.bounds: Capture the authored visual bounds and required glyph-accent, shadow, and motion-travel padding once at setup; do not measure during playback.
mask.completion: At duration remove or fully bypass only the temporary mask, preserving the target's decorative clip-path, mask and normal overflow behavior. Reconstruct the wrapper and mask state when seeking back into the motion.

adaptation: x/y are design pixels at 1080x1920 scaled with the frame. Scale multiplies authored base scale, rotation is additive degrees, and opacity is absolute. Keep wrapper insertion neutral to grid/flex placement, absolute positioning, text wrapping, accessibility semantics and stacking order; an equivalent offscreen mask layer is also valid. Never animate clip-path on the target itself or erase its decorative shape. Initialize only at the assigned start and sample the mask and content from local time.
